{"kind":"tool","id":"S8qhafev9ko","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"db.js","instructions":"Create SQLite database layer with one-time JSON migration","content":"const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite');

const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'data');
const DB_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'pos.db');

if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

const db = new DatabaseSync(DB_PATH);
db.exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;');
db.exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;');

// ==================== SCHEMA ====================
db.exec(`
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password TEXT NOT NULL,
    displayName TEXT DEFAULT '',
    role TEXT DEFAULT 'cashier',
    active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    createdAt TEXT
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    price REAL DEFAULT 0,
    description TEXT DEFAULT '',
    sku TEXT DEFAULT '',
    barcode TEXT DEFAULT '',
    imageUrl TEXT DEFAULT '',
    active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    createdAt TEXT
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    invoiceNumber INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    subtotal REAL DEFAULT 0,
    discount REAL DEFAULT 0,
    taxRate REAL DEFAULT 0,
    taxAmount REAL DEFAULT 0,
    total REAL DEFAULT 0,
    paymentMethod TEXT DEFAULT '',
    cashierName TEXT DEFAULT '',
    createdAt TEXT
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoice_items (
    rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    invoiceId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    productId TEXT DEFAULT '',
    productName TEXT DEFAULT '',
    quantity REAL DEFAULT 0,
    unitPrice REAL DEFAULT 0,
    total REAL DEFAULT 0
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT DEFAULT '',
    amount REAL DEFAULT 0,
    branchId TEXT DEFAULT '',
    branchName TEXT DEFAULT '',
    description TEXT DEFAULT '',
    createdAt TEXT
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    shopName TEXT DEFAULT '',
    address TEXT DEFAULT '',
    phone TEXT DEFAULT '',
    taxId TEXT DEFAULT '',
    taxRate REAL DEFAULT 15,
    receiptWidth TEXT DEFAULT '80mm',
    logoUrl TEXT DEFAULT '',
    branches TEXT DEFAULT '[]'
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT
  );
`);

// ==================== ROW MAPPERS ====================
const bool = (v) => (v ? 1 : 0);
const unbool = (row) => {
  if (row && 'active' in row) row.active = !!row.active;
  return row;
};

function getInvoiceItems(invoiceId) {
  return db
    .prepare(
      'SELECT productId, productName, quantity, unitPrice, total FROM invoice_items WHERE invoiceId = ? ORDER BY rowid'
    )
    .all(invoiceId)
    .map((r) => ({ ...r }));
}

function withItems(invoice) {
  if (!invoice) return invoice;
  return { ...invoice, items: getInvoiceItems(invoice.id) };
}

// ==================== ONE-TIME MIGRATION FROM JSON ====================
function readJsonFile(filename) {
  const fp = path.join(DATA_DIR, filename);
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(fp)) return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`Migration: error reading ${filename}:`, e.message);
  }
  return null;
}

function tableEmpty(table) {
  return db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM ${table}`).get().c === 0;
}

function migrateFromJson() {
  // Users
  if (tableEmpty('users')) {
    const users = readJsonFile('users.json');
    if (Array.isArray(users) && users.length) {
      const stmt = db.prepare(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, username, password, displayName, role, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      for (const u of users) {
        stmt.run(
          String(u.id),
          u.username,
          u.password,
          u.displayName || '',
          u.role || 'cashier',
          bool(u.active !== false),
          u.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
        );
      }
      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${users.length} users from users.json`);
    }
  }

  // Products
  if (tableEmpty('products')) {
    const products = readJsonFile('products.json');
    if (Array.isArray(products) && products.length) {
      const stmt = db.prepare(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO products (id, name, price, description, sku, barcode, imageUrl, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      for (const p of products) {
        stmt.run(
          String(p.id),
          p.name || '',
          Number(p.price) || 0,
          p.description || '',
          p.sku || '',
          p.barcode || '',
          p.imageUrl || '',
          bool(p.active !== false),
          p.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
        );
      }
      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${products.length} products from products.json`);
    }
  }

  // Invoices (+ items) and counter
  if (tableEmpty('invoices')) {
    const invoices = readJsonFile('invoices.json');
    if (Array.isArray(invoices) && invoices.length) {
      const invStmt = db.prepare(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO invoices (id, invoiceNumber, subtotal, discount, taxRate, taxAmount, total, paymentMethod, cashierName, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      const itemStmt = db.prepare(
        'INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoiceId, productId, productName, quantity, unitPrice, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      let maxNumber = 0;
      for (const inv of invoices) {
        invStmt.run(
          String(inv.id),
          Number(inv.invoiceNumber) || 0,
          Number(inv.subtotal) || 0,
          Number(inv.discount) || 0,
          Number(inv.taxRate) || 0,
          Number(inv.taxAmount) || 0,
          Number(inv.total) || 0,
          inv.paymentMethod || '',
          inv.cashierName || '',
          inv.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
        );
        if (Number(inv.invoiceNumber) > maxNumber) maxNumber = Number(inv.invoiceNumber);
        for (const it of inv.items || []) {
          itemStmt.run(
            String(inv.id),
            it.productId ? String(it.productId) : '',
            it.productName || '',
            Number(it.quantity) || 0,
            Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
            Number(it.total) || 0
          );
        }
      }
      // Seed the counter from migrated data (max+1), unless a counter file says higher
      const counterFile = readJsonFile('invoice_counter.json');
      const next = Math.max(
        maxNumber + 1,
        counterFile && Number(counterFile.next) ? Number(counterFile.next) : 1
      );
      db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)').run(
        'invoice_next',
        String(next)
      );
      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${invoices.length} invoices from invoices.json (next number: ${next})`);
    }
  }

  // Expenses (file may not exist yet — created on first use)
  if (tableEmpty('expenses')) {
    const expenses = readJsonFile('expenses.json');
    if (Array.isArray(expenses) && expenses.length) {
      const stmt = db.prepare(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO expenses (id, title, amount, branchId, branchName, description, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      for (const e of expenses) {
        stmt.run(
          String(e.id),
          e.title || '',
          Number(e.amount) || 0,
          e.branchId || '',
          e.branchName || '',
          e.description || '',
          e.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
        );
      }
      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${expenses.length} expenses from expenses.json`);
    }
  }

  // Settings
  if (tableEmpty('settings')) {
    const s = readJsonFile('settings.json');
    if (s && typeof s === 'object') {
      db.prepare(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (id, shopName, address, phone, taxId, taxRate, receiptWidth, logoUrl, branches) VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      ).run(
        s.shopName || '',
        s.address || '',
        s.phone || '',
        s.taxId || '',
        Number(s.taxRate) || 0,
        s.receiptWidth || '80mm',
        s.logoUrl || '',
        JSON.stringify(s.branches || [])
      );
      console.log('📦 Migrated settings from settings.json');
    }
  }

  // Ensure counter row exists
  const counter = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'invoice_next'").get();
  if (!counter) {
    const maxRow = db.prepare('SELECT MAX(invoiceNumber) AS m FROM invoices').get();
    const next = (maxRow && Number(maxRow.m) ? Number(maxRow.m) : 0) + 1;
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)').run('invoice_next', String(next));
  }
}

migrateFromJson();

// ==================== QUERY API ====================
const queries = {
  // ---- users ----
  allUsers: () => db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
  activeUsers: () =>
    db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
  findUserByUsername: (username) => {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(username);
    return r ? unbool({ ...r }) : undefined;
  },
  findUserById: (id) => {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    return r ? unbool({ ...r }) : undefined;
  },
  insertUser: (u) => {
    db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO users (id, username, password, displayName, role, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
    ).run(u.id, u.username, u.password, u.displayName || '', u.role || 'cashier', bool(u.active !== false), u.createdAt);
  },
  updateUser: (id, fields) => {
    const keys = Object.keys(fields);
    if (!keys.length) return;
    const set = keys.map((k) => `${k} = ?`).join(', ');
    db.prepare(`UPDATE users SET ${set} WHERE id = ?`).run(...keys.map((k) => fields[k]), id);
  },
  deactivateUser: (id) => db.prepare('UPDATE users SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?').run(id),

  // ---- products ----
  allProducts: () => db.prepare('SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
  activeProducts: () =>
    db.prepare('SELECT * FROM products WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
  findProductById: (id) => {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?').get(id);

  },
  insertProduct: (p) => {
    db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO products (id, name, price, description, sku, barcode, imageUrl, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
    ).run(
      p.id, p.name || '', Number(p.price) || 0, p.description || '', p.sku || '',
      p.barcode || '', p.imageUrl || '', bool(p.active !== false), p.createdAt
    );
  },
  updateProduct: (id, fields) => {
    const keys = Object.keys(fields);
    if (!keys.length) return;
    const set = keys.map((k) => `${k} = ?`).join(', ');
    db.prepare(`UPDATE products SET ${set} WHERE id = ?`).run(...keys.map((k) => fields[k]), id);
  },
  deleteProduct: (id) => db.prepare('DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?').run(id),
  toggleProduct: (id) => db.prepare('UPDATE products SET active = 1 - active WHERE id = ?').run(id),

  // ---- invoices ----
  allInvoices: () =>
    db.prepare('SELECT * FROM invoices ORDER BY invoiceNumber DESC').all().map((r) => withItems({ ...r })),
  findInvoiceById: (id) => {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    return r ? withItems({ ...r }) : undefined;
  },
  nextInvoiceNumber: () => Number(db.prepare("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'invoice_next'").get().value),
  insertInvoice: (inv) => {
    const insertInv = db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO invoices (id, invoiceNumber, subtotal, discount, taxRate, taxAmount, total, paymentMethod, cashierName, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
    );
    const insertItem = db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoiceId, productId, productName, quantity, unitPrice, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
    );
    const bump = db.prepare("UPDATE meta SET value = ? WHERE key = 'invoice_next'");
    const tx = db.transaction((invoice) => {
      insertInv.run(
        invoice.id, invoice.invoiceNumber, invoice.subtotal, invoice.discount,
        invoice.taxRate, invoice.taxAmount, invoice.total,
        invoice.paymentMethod || '', invoice.cashierName || '', invoice.createdAt
      );
      for (const it of invoice.items || []) {
        insertItem.run(
          invoice.id, it.productId ? String(it.productId) : '', it.productName || '',
          Number(it.quantity) || 0, Number(it.unitPrice) || 0, Number(it.total) || 0
        );
      }
      bump.run(String(invoice.invoiceNumber + 1));
    });
    tx(inv);
  },

  // ---- settings ----
  getSettings: () => {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM settings WHERE id = 1').get();
    if (!r) return null;

      rest.branches = JSON.parse(branches || '[]');
    } catch {
      rest.branches = [];

  },

  allExpenses: () => db.prepare('SELECT * FROM expenses ORDER BY createdAt DESC').all().map((r) => ({ ...r })),

    db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO expenses (id, title, amount, branchId, branchName, description, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
    ).run(e.id, e.title || '', Number(e.amount) || 0, e.branchId || '', e.branchName || '', e.description || '', e.createdAt);
  },
  deleteExpense: (id) => db.prepare('DELETE FROM expenses WHERE id = ?').run(id),
};

{"kind":"tool","id":"S8rasaumWJM","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"server.js","instructions":"Rewrite server.js to use SQLite","content":"const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { queries, DB_PATH, DATA_DIR } = require('./db');

const app = express();
const PORT = (process.env.PORT && process.env.PORT !== '0') ? parseInt(process.env.PORT) : 3000;

function generateId() {
  return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
}

async function hashPassword(password) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(password).digest('hex');
}

// Middleware
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'dist/freebuff-pos/browser')));

// CORS for dev
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  res.header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');
  res.header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,PATCH');
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return res.sendStatus(200);
  next();
});

// ==================== USERS ====================

app.get('/api/users', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.allUsers());
});

app.get('/api/users/active', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.activeUsers());
});

app.post('/api/users/login', async (req, res) => {
  const { username, password } = req.body;
  const hashed = await hashPassword(password);
  const user = queries.findUserByUsername(username);

  if (!user || user.password !== hashed || !user.active) {
    return res.status(401).json({ message: 'اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة' });
  }

  // Return user without password
  const { password: _, ...userWithoutPassword } = user;
  res.json(userWithoutPassword);
});

app.post('/api/users', async (req, res) => {
  if (queries.findUserByUsername(req.body.username)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ message: 'اسم المستخدم موجود بالفعل' });
  }

  const hashed = await hashPassword(req.body.password || '123456');
  const newUser = {
    id: generateId(),
    username: req.body.username,
    password: hashed,
    displayName: req.body.displayName || '',
    role: req.body.role || 'cashier',
    active: true,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  queries.insertUser(newUser);

  const { password: _, ...result } = newUser;
  res.json(result);
});

app.put('/api/users/:id', async (req, res) => {
  const existing = queries.findUserById(req.params.id);

  if (!existing) {
    return res.status(404).json({ message: 'المستخدم غير موجود' });
  }

  const fields = { ...req.body };
  delete fields.id;
  if (fields.password) {
    fields.password = await hashPassword(fields.password);
  } else {
    delete fields.password;
  }
  if ('active' in fields) fields.active = fields.active ? 1 : 0;

  queries.updateUser(req.params.id, fields);

  const updated = queries.findUserById(req.params.id);
  const { password: _, ...result } = updated;
  res.json(result);
});

app.delete('/api/users/:id', (req, res) => {
  const existing = queries.findUserById(req.params.id);

  if (!existing) {
    return res.status(404).json({ message: 'المستخدم غير موجود' });
  }

  queries.deactivateUser(req.params.id);
  res.json({ success: true });
});

// Seed default users if none exist
app.post('/api/users/seed', async (req, res) => {
  if (queries.allUsers().length > 0) {
    return res.json({ seeded: false });
  }

  const adminHash = await hashPassword('123456');
  const cashierHash = await hashPassword('123456');

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  queries.insertUser({
    id: generateId(), username: 'admin', password: adminHash,
    displayName: 'المدير', role: 'admin', active: true, createdAt: now
  });
  queries.insertUser({
    id: generateId(), username: 'cashier', password: cashierHash,
    displayName: 'بائع', role: 'cashier', active: true, createdAt: now
  });

  res.json({ seeded: true });
});

// ==================== PRODUCTS ====================

app.get('/api/products', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.allProducts());
});

app.get('/api/products/active', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.activeProducts());
});

app.get('/api/products/:id', (req, res) => {
  const product = queries.findProductById(req.params.id);
  if (!product) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'المنتج غير موجود' });
  res.json(product);
});

app.post('/api/products', (req, res) => {
  const newProduct = {
    id: generateId(),
    name: req.body.name || '',
    price: Number(req.body.price) || 0,
    description: req.body.description || '',
    sku: req.body.sku || '',
    barcode: req.body.barcode || '',
    imageUrl: req.body.imageUrl || '',
    active: req.body.active !== false,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  queries.insertProduct(newProduct);
  res.json({ ...newProduct });
});

app.put('/api/products/:id', (req, res) => {
  const existing = queries.findProductById(req.params.id);

  if (!existing) {
    return res.status(404).json({ message: 'المنتج غير موجود' });
  }

  const fields = { ...req.body };
  delete fields.id;
  if ('active' in fields) fields.active = fields.active ? 1 : 0;
  if ('price' in fields) fields.price = Number(fields.price) || 0;

  queries.updateProduct(req.params.id, fields);
  res.json(queries.findProductById(req.params.id));
});

app.delete('/api/products/:id', (req, res) => {
  queries.deleteProduct(req.params.id);
  res.json({ success: true });
});

app.patch('/api/products/:id/toggle', (req, res) => {
  const existing = queries.findProductById(req.params.id);

  if (!existing) {
    return res.status(404).json({ message: 'المنتج غير موجود' });
  }

  queries.toggleProduct(req.params.id);
  res.json(queries.findProductById(req.params.id));
});

// Seed default products
app.post('/api/products/seed', (req, res) => {
  if (queries.allProducts().length > 0) {

    { name: 'خبز أبيض', price: 1.00, description: 'ربطة خبز أبيض طازج', sku: 'P002', barcode: '6281000000002', imageUrl: '', active: true },

// ==================== INVOICES ====================

app.get('/api/invoices', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.allInvoices());
});

app.get('/api/invoices/counter', (req, res) => {
  res.json({ next: queries.nextInvoiceNumber() });
});

app.get('/api/invoices/:id', (req, res) => {
  const invoice = queries.findInvoiceById(req.params.id);
  if (!invoice) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'الفاتورة غير موجودة' });
  res.json(invoice);
});

app.post('/api/invoices', (req, res) => {
  const next = queries.nextInvoiceNumber();

  const invoice = {
    id: req.body.id || generateId(),
    invoiceNumber: next,
    subtotal: Number(req.body.subtotal) || 0,
    discount: Number(req.body.discount) || 0,

// ==================== SETTINGS ====================

app.get('/api/settings', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.getSettings());
});

app.put('/api/settings', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.updateSettings(req.body));
});

// ==================== EXPENSES ====================

app.get('/api/expenses', (req, res) => {
  res.json(queries.allExpenses());
});

app.post('/api/expenses', (req, res) => {

  const expense = {

  };

app.delete('/api/expenses/:id', (req, res) => {

app.get('{*path}', (req, res) => {

+const path = require('path');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite');
+
+const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'data');
+const DB_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'pos.db');
+
+if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
+  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
+}
+
+const db = new DatabaseSync(DB_PATH);
+db.exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;');
+db.exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;');
+
+// ==================== SCHEMA ====================
+db.exec(`
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
+    password TEXT NOT NULL,
+    displayName TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    role TEXT DEFAULT 'cashier',
+    active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
+    createdAt TEXT
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    name TEXT NOT NULL,
+    price REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    description TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    sku TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    barcode TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    imageUrl TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
+    createdAt TEXT
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    invoiceNumber INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
+    subtotal REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    discount REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    taxRate REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    taxAmount REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    total REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    paymentMethod TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    cashierName TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    createdAt TEXT
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoice_items (
+    rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+    invoiceId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    productId TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    productName TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    quantity REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    unitPrice REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    total REAL DEFAULT 0
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    title TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    amount REAL DEFAULT 0,
+    branchId TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    branchName TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    description TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    createdAt TEXT
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
+    shopName TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    address TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    phone TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    taxId TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    taxRate REAL DEFAULT 15,
+    receiptWidth TEXT DEFAULT '80mm',
+    logoUrl TEXT DEFAULT '',
+    branches TEXT DEFAULT '[]'
+  );
+
+  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
+    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    value TEXT
+  );
+`);
+
+// ==================== ROW MAPPERS ====================
+const bool = (v) => (v ? 1 : 0);
+const unbool = (row) => {
+  if (row && 'active' in row) row.active = !!row.active;
+  return row;
+};
+
+function getInvoiceItems(invoiceId) {
+  return db
+    .prepare(
+      'SELECT productId, productName, quantity, unitPrice, total FROM invoice_items WHERE invoiceId = ? ORDER BY rowid'
+    )
+    .all(invoiceId)
+    .map((r) => ({ ...r }));
+}
+
+function withItems(invoice) {
+  if (!invoice) return invoice;
+  return { ...invoice, items: getInvoiceItems(invoice.id) };
+}
+
+// ==================== ONE-TIME MIGRATION FROM JSON ====================
+function readJsonFile(filename) {
+  const fp = path.join(DATA_DIR, filename);
+  try {
+    if (fs.existsSync(fp)) return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'));
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error(`Migration: error reading ${filename}:`, e.message);
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function tableEmpty(table) {
+  return db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM ${table}`).get().c === 0;
+}
+
+function migrateFromJson() {
+  // Users
+  if (tableEmpty('users')) {
+    const users = readJsonFile('users.json');
+    if (Array.isArray(users) && users.length) {
+      const stmt = db.prepare(
+        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, username, password, displayName, role, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      );
+      for (const u of users) {
+        stmt.run(
+          String(u.id),
+          u.username,
+          u.password,
+          u.displayName || '',
+          u.role || 'cashier',
+          bool(u.active !== false),
+          u.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
+        );
+      }
+      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${users.length} users from users.json`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Products
+  if (tableEmpty('products')) {
+    const products = readJsonFile('products.json');
+    if (Array.isArray(products) && products.length) {
+      const stmt = db.prepare(
+        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO products (id, name, price, description, sku, barcode, imageUrl, active, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      );
+      for (const p of products) {
+        stmt.run(
+          String(p.id),
+          p.name || '',
+          Number(p.price) || 0,
+          p.description || '',
+          p.sku || '',
+          p.barcode || '',
+          p.imageUrl || '',
+          bool(p.active !== false),
+          p.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
+        );
+      }
+      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${products.length} products from products.json`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Invoices (+ items) and counter
+  if (tableEmpty('invoices')) {
+    const invoices = readJsonFile('invoices.json');
+    if (Array.isArray(invoices) && invoices.length) {
+      const invStmt = db.prepare(
+        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO invoices (id, invoiceNumber, subtotal, discount, taxRate, taxAmount, total, paymentMethod, cashierName, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      );
+      const itemStmt = db.prepare(
+        'INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoiceId, productId, productName, quantity, unitPrice, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      );
+      let maxNumber = 0;
+      for (const inv of invoices) {
+        invStmt.run(
+          String(inv.id),
+          Number(inv.invoiceNumber) || 0,
+          Number(inv.subtotal) || 0,
+          Number(inv.discount) || 0,
+          Number(inv.taxRate) || 0,
+          Number(inv.taxAmount) || 0,
+          Number(inv.total) || 0,
+          inv.paymentMethod || '',
+          inv.cashierName || '',
+          inv.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
+        );
+        if (Number(inv.invoiceNumber) > maxNumber) maxNumber = Number(inv.invoiceNumber);
+        for (const it of inv.items || []) {
+          itemStmt.run(
+            String(inv.id),
+            it.productId ? String(it.productId) : '',
+            it.productName || '',
+            Number(it.quantity) || 0,
+            Number(it.unitPrice) || 0,
+            Number(it.total) || 0
+          );
+        }
+      }
+      // Seed the counter from migrated data (max+1), unless a counter file says higher
+      const counterFile = readJsonFile('invoice_counter.json');
+      const next = Math.max(
+        maxNumber + 1,
+        counterFile && Number(counterFile.next) ? Number(counterFile.next) : 1
+      );
+      db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)').run(
+        'invoice_next',
+        String(next)
+      );
+      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${invoices.length} invoices from invoices.json (next number: ${next})`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Expenses (file may not exist yet — created on first use)
+  if (tableEmpty('expenses')) {
+    const expenses = readJsonFile('expenses.json');
+    if (Array.isArray(expenses) && expenses.length) {
+      const stmt = db.prepare(
+        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO expenses (id, title, amount, branchId, branchName, description, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      );
+      for (const e of expenses) {
+        stmt.run(
+          String(e.id),
+          e.title || '',
+          Number(e.amount) || 0,
+          e.branchId || '',
+          e.branchName || '',
+          e.description || '',
+          e.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
+        );
+      }
+      console.log(`📦 Migrated ${expenses.length} expenses from expenses.json`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Settings
+  if (tableEmpty('settings')) {
+    const s = readJsonFile('settings.json');
+    if (s && typeof s === 'object') {
+      db.prepare(
+        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (id, shopName, address, phone, taxId, taxRate, receiptWidth, logoUrl, branches) VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
+      ).run(
+        s.shopName || '',
+        s.address || '',
+        s.phone || '',
+        s.taxId || '',
+        Number(s.taxRate) || 0,
+        s.receiptWidth || '80mm',
+        s.logoUrl || '',
+        JSON.stringify(s.branches || [])
+      );
+      console.log('📦 Migrated settings from settings.json');
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Ensure counter row exists
+  const counter = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'invoice_next'").get();
+  if (!counter) {
+    const maxRow = db.prepare('SELECT MAX(invoiceNumber) AS m FROM invoices').get();
+    const next = (maxRow && Number(maxRow.m) ? Number(maxRow.m) : 0) + 1;
+    db.prepare('INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)').run('invoice_next', String(next));
+  }
+}
+
+migrateFromJson();
+
+// ==================== QUERY API ====================
+const queries = {
+  // ---- users ----
+  allUsers: () => db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
+  activeUsers: () =>
+    db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY createdAt').all().map((r) => unbool({ ...r })),
+  findUserByUsername: (username) => {
+    const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(username);
+    return r ? unbool({ ...r }) : undefined;

**Yes—MonsterASP.NET currently documents hosting Node.js backend applications, including Express.** Its supported-technologies guide lists Node.js, and its Git deployment guide explicitly includes Express among the supported “Node.js SSR app” types.

### 1. Node.js support and how it runs

MonsterASP.NET’s current instructions use **IIS HttpPlatformHandler**, not IISNode or Plesk. IIS starts the Node process and forwards web requests to it. Your app must listen on the port supplied in `process.env.PORT`; a fixed port such as 3000 will not work.

For a manual deployment, the documented process is to:

- Put the app and `web.config` in `/wwwroot`.
- Install dependencies locally and upload `node_modules` with the app. The guide says you cannot run `npm` or `node` commands on the server.
- Configure `web.config` to start your entry point, such as `server.js`, through HttpPlatformHandler.

There is also a **GitHub deployment** option. For an Express app, choose “Node.js SSR app”: the platform builds the application, includes `node_modules`, and generates the `web.config`. The repository needs a `package.json` with a `build` script; the start command is detected after the first build and can be overridden.

**IISNode is mentioned in an older MonsterASP.NET community announcement**, but the current step-by-step Node.js guide specifies HttpPlatformHandler. I would follow the current guide rather than base a deployment on IISNode. I found no evidence that Plesk or Everleap is the deployment method.

### 2. Does this apply to `runasp.net` subdomains?

The docs describe `runasp.net` as one of the free subdomain choices when creating a MonsterASP.NET website, and say that a subdomain website is a separate website with its own resources, files, and settings. The Node.js guide applies to a website generally, and Node.js is listed as a supported technology. So **the documentation supports the conclusion that a Node.js site can use a `*.runasp.net` address**; it does not describe `runasp.net` as a separate hosting platform with a different Node.js deployment method.

### 3. SQLite and persistent file storage

I could **not verify an explicit MonsterASP.NET guarantee** that the Node process has write permission to `App_Data`—or that SQLite is specifically supported there. The platform’s supported database list names SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, not SQLite. That omission does not prove SQLite cannot work; it means the hosting docs do not confirm it.

There is useful but limited evidence about persistence:

- The Git deploy guide says deployment leaves existing files not tracked by the repository, including `App_Data`, untouched.
- The application-restart guide describes restarts and recommends keeping important state in a database or a website folder rather than in process memory. It does **not** say that `App_Data` is writable by Node or promise a SQLite-specific persistence guarantee.
- The Free plan has no automatic daily backups; Premium includes daily backups retained for 14 days. Free websites may be archived after six months without use.

**Practical recommendation:** ask support to confirm Node’s write access to a chosen data directory before relying on SQLite. If they confirm it, use a directory outside files replaced by deployment (or protect the relevant path), test database creation and writes under the running Node app, and keep separate backups. Files on disk should not be confused with in-memory state lost when a process restarts; however, the provider’s public docs do not explicitly guarantee SQLite-file retention across every kind of recycle or hosting event.

## Sources read

- [Run a Node.js application](https://help.monsterasp.net/websites/frameworks/nodejs) — HttpPlatformHandler, `PORT`, `web.config`, FTP/SFTP and local dependency deployment.
- [Deploy from a GitHub repository](https://help.monsterasp.net/websites/git-deploy/github-repository) — Node.js SSR workflow, Express support, build requirements, generated configuration, and treatment of `App_Data`.
- [Supported technologies](https://help.monsterasp.net/getting-started/first-steps/supported-technologies) — lists Node.js and the platform’s supported databases.
- [Create your first website](https://help.monsterasp.net/getting-started/first-steps/create-first-website) — free `runasp.net` subdomain setup.
- [Free and Premium plans compared](https://help.monsterasp.net/getting-started/first-steps/free-vs-premium) — subdomain websites, storage, backups, and inactivity policy.
- [Application keeps restarting or loses sessions](https://help.monsterasp.net/troubleshooting/common-errors/application-restarts) — restart causes and guidance to persist state.

{"kind":"reasoning","id":"p11-9e75b70d","text":"Summarizing a frontend deployment plan for GitHub Pages with Angular build and API base URL configuration.Adding backend env support for DB path and guarding static serving for FTP deployment.","open":false,"collapse":"preview"}
All decisions locked in: **SQLite file, Node 22.5+, manual FTP for the backend, fresh GitHub repo for the frontend.** Here's the full plan:

## Frontend → GitHub Pages (via GitHub Actions)
1. **Create repo + push** — new GitHub repo, push `main` (code isn't on GitHub yet).
2. **Point prod API at MonsterASP** — set `apiBaseUrl` in [environment.prod.ts](src/environments/environment.prod.ts) to `https://almasa.runasp.net` (services already append `/api/...`, and your [proxy.conf.json](proxy.conf.json) already targets that host, so dev stays consistent).
3. **Add workflow** `.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml` — on push to `main`: setup Node 22 → `npm ci` → `ng build` (prod file replacements apply automatically) → publish `dist/freebuff-pos/browser` to the `gh-pages` branch. Your existing `deploy`/`cname` config (`almasa.ahmed-hassan.site`) is reused; the workflow also copies `index.html` → `404.html` so Angular routing survives page refresh on Pages.
4. **DNS + Pages settings** — `CNAME almasa → <user>.github.io`, set custom domain in repo settings, enforce HTTPS.

## Backend + SQLite → MonsterASP (manual FTP)
1. **Backend-only hardening of [server.js](server.js)** — guard the `dist/` static serving + SPA fallback behind an existence check (no `dist` will exist on the host), keep `process.env.PORT` (IIS HttpPlatformHandler injects the port — already supported), keep CORS open (or lock to your Pages domain).
2. **Move the DB path** — add `DB_PATH` env support in [db.js](db.js) defaulting to `data/pos.db`, set to `App_Data/pos.db` on the host (writable, web-protected, survives FTP overwrites).
3. **Write `web.config`** — HttpPlatformHandler entry pointing at `server.js` per [MonsterASP's Node.js guide](https://help.monsterasp.net/websites/frameworks/nodejs).
4. **Upload via FTP** — `server.js`, `db.js`, `package.json`, `node_modules` (installed locally — the host runs no npm), `web.config`, plus your current `data/*.json` files once as migration seeds. First request auto-imports everything into `App_Data/pos.db`.
5. **Panel + verify** — set Node 22+ on the site, hit `/api/settings`, `/api/products`, login; confirm writes persist across an app restart. Back up by downloading `pos.db` over FTP periodically (Free plan has no auto-backups).

**Risk note:** MonsterASP documents SQL Server/MySQL/PostgreSQL but not SQLite, so file-write persistence isn't guaranteed in writing — the plan keeps your JSON files as fallback seeds and includes a write-persistence check right after deploy; if it ever misbehaves, the fallback is switching `db.js` to their SQL Server offering.

Approving this plan switches the thread to build mode and queues the implementation.

import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { environment } from 'environments/environment';
import { Invoice, InvoiceItem, PaymentMethod } from '../models';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { SettingsService } from './settings.service';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class InvoiceService {
  private http = inject(HttpClient);
  private cartService = inject(CartService);
  private authService = inject(AuthService);
  private settingsService = inject(SettingsService);

  private readonly _invoices = signal<Invoice[]>([]);
  readonly invoices = this._invoices.asReadonly();

  async loadInvoices(): Promise<void> {
    const invoices = await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Invoice[]>(`${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/invoices`));
    this._invoices.set((invoices || []).map(inv => ({
      ...inv,
      customerName: inv.customerName || '',
      customerPhone: inv.customerPhone || '',
      guestsCount: Number(inv.guestsCount) || 0
    })));
  }

  async completeSale(
    paymentMethod: PaymentMethod,
    branchName: string,
    customer: { name?: string; phone?: string; guests?: number | null } = {}
  ): Promise<Invoice> {
    const items = this.cartService.items();
    const discount = this.cartService.discount();
    const subtotal = this.cartService.subtotal();
    const currentUser = this.authService.currentUser();

    const total = Math.round((subtotal - discount) * 100) / 100;

    const invoiceItems: InvoiceItem[] = items.map(item => ({
      productId: item.product.id,
      productName: item.product.name,
      quantity: item.quantity,
      unitPrice: item.product.price,
      total: Math.round(item.product.price * item.quantity * 100) / 100
    }));

    const invoice: Invoice = {
      id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9),
      invoiceNumber: 0,
      items: invoiceItems,
      subtotal: Math.round(subtotal * 100) / 100,
      discount: Math.round(discount * 100) / 100,
      total,
      paymentMethod,
      cashierName: currentUser?.displayName ?? 'غير معروف',
      branchName,
      customerName: customer.name?.trim() ?? '',
      customerPhone: customer.phone?.trim() ?? '',
      guestsCount: customer.guests && customer.guests > 0 ? Math.floor(customer.guests) : 0,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    const saved = await firstValueFrom(this.http.post<Invoice>(`${environment.apiBaseUrl}/api/invoices`, invoice));
    this._invoices.update(list => [saved, ...list]);
    this.cartService.clear();
    return saved;
  }

  getInvoiceById(id: string): Invoice | undefined {
    return this._invoices().find(inv => inv.id === id);
  }

  searchInvoices(query: string): Invoice[] {
    const q = query.trim();
    if (!q) return this._invoices();
    return this._invoices().filter(inv =>
      inv.invoiceNumber.toString().includes(q) ||
      (inv.customerName || '').includes(q) ||
      (inv.customerPhone || '').includes(q)
    );
  }

  getTodaySales(): { total: number; count: number } {
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    const todayInvoices = this._invoices().filter(inv =>
      new Date(inv.createdAt).toDateString() === today
    );
    return {
      total: todayInvoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + inv.total, 0),
      count: todayInvoices.length
    };
  }

  getTopProducts(limit: number = 5): { name: string; count: number; total: number }[] {
    const map = new Map<string, { name: string; count: number; total: number }>();
    for (const inv of this._invoices()) {
      for (const item of inv.items) {
        const existing = map.get(item.productId);
        if (existing) {
          existing.count += item.quantity;
          existing.total += item.total;
        } else {
          map.set(item.productId, {
            name: item.productName,
            count: item.quantity,
            total: item.total
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(map.values())
      .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
      .slice(0, limit);
  }

  getRecentInvoices(limit: number = 5): Invoice[] {
    return this._invoices().slice(0, limit);
  }
}
"}}
